nodes.name: Basic Math Concepts II — Linear Algebra for AI
nodes.summary: PHP lesson on linear algebra for AI — vector spaces, matrices/tensors, function composition, the Hadamard product, transposition, and softmax/cross-entropy — with inline Plotly.js visualizations (1D–4D vector spaces, RGB image tensor, composition, Hadamard) that lazy-render on scroll.
nodes.languageNotes: All interactivity lives in inline <script> inside the PHP file (no separate .js); heavy 3-D Plotly surfaces are lazy-rendered via an IntersectionObserver (lazyRender/observePlot).

nodes.name: loadMathIIModule
nodes.summary: Module-queue entry point for this lesson; kicks off initialization of the Math II plot suite once loaded.

nodes.name: initDataBasics
nodes.summary: Bootstrap that runs cheap global work immediately and defers each heavy section behind a lazyInit until its container scrolls near the viewport.

nodes.name: initMathIIPlots
nodes.summary: One-time initializer that renders the Math II Plotly visualizations (BW/RGB image tensors, vector plots, composition, Hadamard, interactive vector spaces) once Plotly is available.

nodes.name: lazyRender
nodes.summary: Central lazy-render primitive: stores the latest render callback for a plot and either draws it now (if visible) or queues it for the IntersectionObserver to fire on scroll-in.

nodes.name: initInteractiveVectorSpaces
nodes.summary: Wires the 1D–4D interactive vector-space plots (line, plane, RGB color cube, 4D feature bar chart) to their sliders, with the 3-D scatter lazy-rendered.

nodes.name: renderELI5Math
nodes.summary: Sets up the 'ELI5' mixed 2-D/3-D step plots (linear, surface, waves, static f=x+y) with one-shot observers for cheap 2-D plots and lazy rendering for 3-D surfaces.

nodes.name: initCompositionPlot
nodes.summary: Sets up the function-composition widget: reads a/b/c/d sliders, plots f, g, and (g∘f), and re-renders the composition formula on input.

nodes.name: initHadamard
nodes.summary: Attaches input listeners to the six Hadamard vector cells and triggers the initial Hadamard product computation.

nodes.name: runHadamardExperiment
nodes.summary: Reads the two 3-element vectors and writes the element-wise (Hadamard) product into the display as a LaTeX pmatrix.

nodes.name: initLogPlot
nodes.summary: Sets up the logarithm widget: base and x sliders drive a Plotly log curve, a 'your value' marker, and the log⇄exponent formula.

nodes.name: renderVectorPlot
nodes.summary: Renders the static 2-D vector visualization of the arrow [3,4] with a labeled arrowhead annotation.

nodes.name: renderMovableVector
nodes.summary: Renders the movable-vector widget: a fixed [2,3] vector translated to a user-chosen start position via range sliders.

nodes.name: Basic Math Concepts III — Approximation, High Dimensions & a Taste of Type Theory
nodes.summary: PHP lesson on approximation, high-dimensional geometry (curse vs. blessing of dimensionality, concentration of measure, manifold hypothesis) and a tour of type theory / homotopy type theory (HoTT), with an interactive HoTT lab (path deformation, equality-as-path, Bloch sphere) driven by math_iii_hott.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Lesson body ships scoped .hott-* CSS plus an inline HoTT interactive lab; the module js('math_iii_hott') and the lab logic live in math_iii_hott.js.

nodes.name: loadMathIIIModule
nodes.summary: Module-queue entry point for the Math III lesson; triggers the HoTT lab bootstrap (implemented in math_iii_hott.js).

nodes.name: Basic Math Concepts IV — Affine Maps & the Fold
nodes.summary: PHP lesson on affine maps (Mx + t, homogeneous coordinates, projective/Möbius) and the fold — the first non-affine move, equivalent to a ReLU — culminating in unthreading a Hopf link; interactive 2D/3D affine machines and fold/unlink labs are driven by math_iv_affine.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Lesson body ships scoped .af-* CSS and an inline loadMathIVModule stub; the affine/fold/unlink lab logic lives in math_iv_affine.js.

nodes.name: loadMathIVModule
nodes.summary: Guarded module-queue entry point stub for the Math IV lesson; the real affine/fold/unlink lab logic lives in math_iv_affine.js.

nodes.name: statistics_i.js
nodes.summary: Loader module for the Statistics I lesson; re-bootstraps the shared statistics.js lab (guarded by window.__statisticsModuleLoaded) so it runs standalone or inside the combined course page.
nodes.languageNotes: Dynamic <script> injection of the shared statistics.js, guarded by a global flag so it is evaluated only once.

nodes.name: loadStatisticsIModule
nodes.summary: Module-queue entry point for Statistics I: sets the loading status, ensures statistics.js is loaded, then bootstraps loadStatisticsModule() exactly once.

nodes.name: _statEnsureStatisticsJs
nodes.summary: Injects a <script src='statistics.js'> tag on demand (resolving when loaded or failed) so the shared lab can be reused by both statistics lessons.

nodes.name: Statistics I — Distributions and Inference
nodes.summary: PHP lesson introducing probability distributions and inference — Bernoulli, Binomial, Normal, Gumbel, Poisson, the Central Limit Theorem, Z-scores, the Phi-table, least squares, and correlation — with interactive Plotly labs loaded from statistics.js.

nodes.name: statistics_ii.js
nodes.summary: Loader module for the Statistics II lesson; injects the shared statistics.js lab on demand and re-bootstraps it (guarded by window.__statisticsModuleLoaded).
nodes.languageNotes: Dynamic <script> injection of the shared statistics.js, guarded by a global flag so it is evaluated only once.

nodes.name: loadStatisticsIIModule
nodes.summary: Module-queue entry point for Statistics II: sets the loading status, ensures statistics.js is loaded, then bootstraps loadStatisticsModule() exactly once.

nodes.name: _statEnsureStatisticsJs
nodes.summary: Injects a <script src='statistics.js'> tag on demand so the shared statistics lab can be loaded standalone or inside the combined course page.

nodes.name: Statistics II — Inference and Information
nodes.summary: PHP lesson on statistical inference and information — Bayesian updating, Shannon entropy, the Dirichlet distribution, Gaussian mixtures / EM, the law of large numbers, Markov chains, Boltzmann/temperature, MLE, the chain rule, KL divergence, and bag-of-words — with interactive labs in statistics.js.
